question: Can you use CytoConverter genomic coordinates to calculate the frequency of chromosomal gains and losses across a cohort of breast cancer (morphology='3111') and adenocarcinoma (topology='0401') samples? Concretely, please include the number and frequency (2 decimals in percentage) of amplifications (gains of more than 1 copy), gains (1 extra copy), losses (1 copy) and homozygous deletions (loss of 2 copies) for each chromosomal band. And sort the result by the ordinal of each chromosome and the starting-ending base-pair position of each band in ascending order.
sql:
WITH filtered_samples AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT RefNo, CaseNo 
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.Cytogen` 
  WHERE Morph = '3111' AND Topo = '0401'
),
cyto_data AS (
  SELECT cy.Chr, cy.ChrOrd, cy.Start, cy.`End`, cy.Type, cb.cytoband_name, cb.hg38_start, cb.hg38_stop
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` cy
  JOIN filtered_samples fs ON cy.RefNo = fs.RefNo AND cy.CaseNo = fs.CaseNo
  JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.CytoBands_hg38` cb ON cy.Chr = cb.chromosome AND cy.Start >= cb.hg38_start AND cy.Start < cb.hg38_stop
),
band_type_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    cytoband_name,
    ChrOrd,
    hg38_start,
    hg38_stop,
    Type,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM cyto_data
  GROUP BY cytoband_name, ChrOrd, hg38_start, hg38_stop, Type
),
band_totals AS (
  SELECT cytoband_name, ChrOrd, hg38_start, hg38_stop, SUM(count) as total
  FROM band_type_counts
  GROUP BY cytoband_name, ChrOrd, hg38_start, hg38_stop
)
SELECT 
  bt.cytoband_name,
  bt.ChrOrd,
  bt.hg38_start,
  bt.hg38_stop,
  MAX(CASE WHEN btc.Type = 'Gain' THEN btc.count ELSE 0 END) as amplifications,
  0 as gains,
  MAX(CASE WHEN btc.Type = 'Loss' THEN btc.count ELSE 0 END) as losses,
  0 as homozygous_deletions,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(MAX(CASE WHEN btc.Type = 'Gain' THEN btc.count ELSE 0 END), bt.total) * 100, 2) as amplification_freq,
  0.0 as gain_freq,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(MAX(CASE WHEN btc.Type = 'Loss' THEN btc.count ELSE 0 END), bt.total) * 100, 2) as loss_freq,
  0.0 as homozygous_deletion_freq
FROM band_type_counts btc
JOIN band_totals bt ON bt.cytoband_name = btc.cytoband_name AND bt.ChrOrd = btc.ChrOrd AND bt.hg38_start = btc.hg38_start AND bt.hg38_stop = btc.hg38_stop
GROUP BY bt.cytoband_name, bt.ChrOrd, bt.hg38_start, bt.hg38_stop, bt.total
ORDER BY bt.ChrOrd, bt.hg38_start
